name: MARE5.1
summary: MARE5.1 is a trend-following Expert Advisor that uses moving average-based signals to identify and trade with the prevailing market trend. It generates buy signals when price crosses above key moving averages and sell signals when price crosses below, employing range filters to avoid choppy markets. The EA manages positions with stop-loss and take-profit levels while applying position sizing based on account equity.
summary_zh: MARE5.1是一个基于移动均线的趋势跟踪EA，通过均线交叉信号识别并跟随市场主导趋势。当价格突破关键均线时产生买入信号，跌破时产生卖出信号，同时使用区间过滤避免震荡行情。该EA通过止损和止盈管理仓位，并根据账户权益进行仓位调整。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于移动均线的趋势跟踪，利用快速均线与慢速均线的交叉作为入场信号。当快速均线向上穿越慢速均线且价格位于均线上方时开多单，反之开空单。出场条件包括固定止损止盈以及均线反向交叉信号。仓位管理采用基于账户余额百分比的固定比例下单方式，风险暴露相对可控。资金管理方面，EA可能包含最大持仓数量限制和单笔最大亏损限制。此外，版本号5.1表明经过多次迭代优化，策略相对成熟，但仍需关注趋势行情中均线滞后性带来的入场延迟问题。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following based on moving average crossovers, using fast and slow MA crossings as entry signals. Long positions are opened when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA and price trades above the MAs, while short positions follow the reverse logic. Exit conditions include fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels as well as reverse MA crossover signals. Position sizing uses a fixed percentage of account balance for each trade, keeping risk exposure relatively controlled. Money management likely includes maximum position count limits and per-trade maximum loss constraints. The version number 5.1 indicates multiple iterations of optimization, suggesting a relatively mature strategy, though the inherent lag of moving averages in trending markets remains a concern for entry timing.

使用均线交叉系统，逻辑清晰易懂
经过多次迭代(5.1版本)，策略相对成熟稳定
